conn = sqlite3.connect('workday_data.db')

SELECT 
    e.employee_id,
    e.first_name,
    e.last_name,
    e.department,
    p.position_title,
    p.job_level,
    s.base_salary,
    s.bonus,
    s.total_compensation

    employees e

    positions p ON e.employee_id = p.employee_id

    salaries s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id

        cursor.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table_name})")
        columns = [col[1] for col in cursor.fetchall()]
        print(f"Columns: {columns}")
        
        # Stream data in chunks to handle large datasets
        chunk_size = 1000
        offset = 0
        total_rows = 0
        
        while True:
            query = f"SELECT * FROM {table_name} LIMIT {chunk_size} OFFSET {offset}"
            cursor.execute(query)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            
            if not rows:
                break
                
            # Display the chunk
            df_chunk = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=columns)
            print(f"\nRows {offset + 1} to {offset + len(rows)}:")
            print(df_chunk.to_string(index=False))
            
            total_rows += len(rows)
            offset += chunk_size
        
        print(f"\nTotal rows in '{table_name}': {total_rows}")

conn.close()
